# Suraj Malpani

> Suraj Malpani is a Data & AI Engineer with 10+ years of building data products for Nike, Microsoft, Daimler, and Accenture. He now builds real-time streaming pipelines and agentic AI systems, with a focus on sustainability, waste, and food.

Portfolio: https://surajmalpani.github.io/

## Services

- Data & AI Engineering
- Agentic AI Solutions
- Data Product Development
- Policy Analysis
- Sustainability Consulting

## Projects

- [Vedic Kundali](https://kundli.vayuputra.co/): Vedic birth chart (Janam Kundli) generator.
- [Kundali Milan](https://match.vayuputra.co/): Ashtakoot (36 guna) compatibility calculator with a perfect-match finder.
- [Drinkee](https://drinkee.vayuputra.co/): Cocktail recommender by ingredients, weather, mood, and strength.
- [Munchee](https://munchee.vayuputra.co/): Vegetarian and vegan recipe finder from the ingredients you have.
- [H-1B Employer Explorer](https://h1b.vayuputra.co/): USCIS H-1B approvals, denials, and salaries by employer since FY 2009.
- [Germany Visa Sponsor Explorer](https://germany.vayuputra.co/): German employers offering visa, Blue Card, or relocation support, with salaries.
- [Mango](https://mango.vayuputra.co/): Gentle yoga session builder for how you feel today.
- [Bingo 2027](https://bingo.vayuputra.co/): Personal bingo card of 24 things to do in 2027.
- [Hola](https://hola.vayuputra.co/): Spanish and Portuguese flashcards with pronunciation.
- [Wai](https://wai.vayuputra.co/): Thai flashcards with Bangkok pronunciation and tone marks.

All free tools are published by [Vayuputra](https://vayuputra.co/), his independent studio.
